title: Cosmic Lotus Enlightenment
description: A glowing blue meditating figure sits in lotus position on a giant luminous flower in the foreground. Behind them floats a massive green-skinned Buddha-like alien with multiple eyes and a serene smile, contained within a radiant cosmic orb filled with stars, nebulae, and floating rocks.
prompt: A glowing blue translucent human meditating in lotus pose on a giant bioluminescent lotus flower in a barren rocky landscape. Behind him floats a massive green-skinned multi-eyed Buddha alien with a joyful expression, radiating golden light inside a giant transparent sphere containing stars, colorful nebulae, and floating rocks, dramatic cosmic lighting, surreal fantasy style
